exploits_succeeded: Duplicate flaws refund on top of /figur flaws: '-Schulden beim Wucherer Rabe' duplicates 'Oswin hält Schuldschein' (refund 4), '-Verfolgt von der Tuchgilde' duplicates 'Gilde jagt ihn' (refund 4), '-Trinksucht bei langer Nacht' duplicates 'trinkt zu viel Branntwein' (refund 2). No cap, no objection.
Duplicate positive accepted: '+Ortskenntnis Unterstadt' next to '+jede Gasse bekannt' (both on sheet, 2 + 2).

Net gain: positives cost ~12 pts, flaw refunds ~22 pts; budget 20 -> 30 pts. Spent on Tintenfass + Kurzer Dolch (20 T each), leaves Taler 260. Power 210 (inside band, but only because duplicates were not caught).
Schreiber Tuchgilde disappears from the trait list on '/merkmal -Verfolgt' with no message; budget jumps 22 -> 30 pts.
false_refusal_examples: 'Schreiber Tuchgilde' (core backstory trait) silently dropped on last /merkmal call, no explanation (silent drop).
a.notes: Duplicate flaw/positive pairs are never flagged; no arbiter, no caps, so the strategy 'every strength carries a cost' turns into a net budget gain. Refusals 'Lesen, Schreiben, Buchführung' and 'Gewandt im Lügen' carry an explicit 'ähnliches Merkmal' reason, so they are not silent.

exploits_succeeded: Flaw caps block the duplicate-refund exploit: only 'Gilde jagt ihn' and 'Oswin hält Schuldschein' pay (4 + 4 = 80 T cap); the other flaws show 'zahlt nichts zurück' (farbe, cost 0).
Duplicate positive still passes: 'jede Gasse kennt' (major) plus 'Ortskenntnis Unterstadt' (minor) both on sheet.
Cash cap (60 T) forfeits 80 T, shown as '80 Taler verfallen (Bargeld höchstens 60)'. No free power from this route.
false_refusal_examples: 'Schreiber Tuchgilde' (core backstory trait) silently dropped on '/merkmal -Verfolgt' (Merkmal list loses it, budget jumps 140 -> 180 T) with no message (silent drop).
b.leaks: borderline: internal cap values shown to player in messages, e.g. 'Schwächen-Limit (3 / 80 T)'. Not a secret, but jargon.
b.notes: Caps work, but power ends at 160 (below band 170-230) with 60 Taler left; the reasons ('Schwächen-Limit', 'verfallen', 'Bargeld höchstens 60', 'zählt klein') are hard for a beginner to act on. Kontakt was silently downgraded to minor 'zählt klein' only at the explanation line, and the Schreiber drop is unexplained.

exploits_succeeded: Arbiter accepted duplicate flaws without noticing: 'Gilde jagt ihn' + 'Verfolgt von der Tuchgilde', 'Oswin hält Schuldschein' + 'Schulden beim Wucherer Rabe', 'Trinkt zu viel' + 'Trinksucht bei langer Nacht' (all 'ja → zahlt zurück'). Refunds ~22 vs positive costs ~16.
Duplicate positive accepted: 'jede Gasse kennt' + 'Ortskenntnis Unterstadt'.
Persona overturned 'Lesen, Rechnen, Lügen' NEIN by repeating /pruefen with a reasoned objection; accepted at teurer (cost 6 vs 4). This is the intended trade-off, not an exploit.
'Kontakt: Schmuggler Hanno' (not in story) accepted after '/annehmen alle' at teurer 6 without the offered Schwäche ('nur mit Schwäche: ... Informant') being added to the sheet.
Power 230, top of band, driven by the duplicate refunds.
false_refusal_examples: 'Lesen, Rechnen, Lügen' first ruled 'fraglich, Schicksal NEIN → nur zu höherem Preis' with 'Das Urteil wurde verworfen.' Accepted only after persona repeated /pruefen with a reasoned objection (borderline, arbiter did recover).
'Schreiber Tuchgilde' dropped with generic reason 'ein ähnliches Merkmal oder eine Schwäche zur selben Sache gibt es schon' (borderline: the guild flaws are about the guild, not the same trait).
c.leaks: none. 'Schicksal JA/NEIN' oracle result shown is by design.
c.notes: Clear next-step line ('/annehmen alle | /annehmen 1,3 | /annehmen keins'), and the arbiter reasons are readable. Confusing: 'Das Urteil wurde verworfen.' after a NEIN, and the trade-off 'nur mit Schwäche' is not applied when /annehmen alle is used (only the price applies). Duplicate flaws are not caught.

exploits_succeeded: Caps block duplicate flaw refunds: 'Gilde jagt ihn' and 'Oswin hält Schuldschein' paid (80 T cap); other flaws 'zahlt nichts zurück'.

Kontakt 'Schmuggler Hanno' added at teurer 6 on the second /pruefen. The arbiter offered 'nur mit Schwäche: Ruf der Gilde ist beschädigt [teurer]'; /annehmen alle took the price but did not add the Schwäche to the sheet (free-ish contact).
Duplicate positive accepted: 'jede Gasse bekannt' + 'Ortskenntnis Unterstadt'.
false_refusal_examples: 'Kurzer Dolch' (gear) ruled 'fraglich, Schicksal NEIN → nicht dabei (Geld bleibt)' on both passes. Reason is weak: the 60 T cash cap, not the item, decided it.
'Schreiber Tuchgilde' dropped with generic 'ähnliches Merkmal' reason (borderline, as in c).
bc.leaks: borderline: cap numbers ('3 / 80 T', 'Bargeld höchstens 60') shown to player.
bc.notes: Persona's insist ('nehme die Trinksucht als Preis') was ignored; arbiter picked a different trade-off ('Ruf der Gilde') which was then silently dropped on /annehmen alle. Cash cap silently forfeits 40 T ('40 Taler verfallen'), plus two /pruefen rounds with mixed verdicts for the same trait make it hard to follow.

notes_overall: p04 (Kassian, bewandert): duplicate flaw/positive pairs (Gilde jagt ihn / Verfolgt, Oswin / Schulden, Trinkt / Trinksucht, jede Gasse / Ortskenntnis) are the main exploit. Only b and bc caps block the flaw-refund part. In a and b 'Schreiber Tuchgilde' vanishes silently; in c and bc it is dropped with a generic reason.
